targets.direct_cause_statement: All figure and table targets now have an independent clean-input implementation, checkpointed 16x67 production contract, and paper-scale table postprocessor, but the full optimizer ensemble has not been executed.
targets.root_cause_statement: The acceptance contract requires 1072 CPU tree-search work units with 600000 anneal and 60000 polish steps each. Two isolated probes imply roughly 22.8 to 312.3 serial CPU-hours across the nonuniform circuit set; the available A100 does not accelerate the unported NNI search.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Run the frozen 32-shard CPU campaign to completion, merge all 1072 hashed records, emit Table 1/5 outputs, and perform post-hoc scientific comparison and fresh-context falsification review.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No implementation defect was found: tree invariants, plan round-tripping, exact cost laws, independent kappa accumulation, clean archive provenance, all-row table emission, and isolated figure/search probes pass.

checks.statement: Focused tests cover independent tree optimization, realification identities, frozen-plan reconstruction, table partitions, and multiseed aggregation.
The figure search path ran in isolation with every declared input read and no forbidden access.
The Table 1 and Table 5 emitters ran every declared row in isolation from clean circuit topology only.
A large-circuit probe and a tiny all-path smoke quantify the 1072-unit production range and the non-applicability of the A100 to the current search implementation.
